mapper.sql: select id, plan_id, user_id, device_id, zone_id, status, remark, photos, deleted, creator, creator_time, modifier, modifier_time from d_plan_user

select pu.id, pu.plan_id, pu.user_id, pu.device_id, pu.zone_id, pu.status, pu.remark, pu.photos, pu.deleted, pu.creator, pu.creator_time, pu.modifier, pu.modifier_time, d.device_name, d.device_code, z.zone_name, u.real_name as user_name, p.plan_name from d_plan_user pu left join c_device d on pu.device_id = d.id left join g_zone z on pu.zone_id = z.id left join sys_user u on pu.user_id = u.id left join d_inspection_plan p on pu.plan_id = p.id
mapper.insert: insert into d_plan_user (plan_id, user_id, device_id, zone_id, status, remark, photos, creator, modifier) values (#{planId}, #{userId}, #{deviceId}, #{zoneId}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{photos}, #{creator}, #{modifier}) on duplicate key update status = values(status), remark = values(remark), photos = values(photos), modifier = values(modifier), modifier_time = now()
